verdict.rationale: Airbyte's sync-schedule docs say each connection can be set to one of three Schedule Types: Scheduled, Cron, or Manual. Cron runs syncs on a user-defined cron expression, and the pricing page lists 15-minute syncs, which covers sub-hour frequency. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the available scheduled intervals (sub-hour support appears only as a pricing-page line and may be plan-dependent), and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling behavior.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I control sync frequency per pipeline — from sub-hour schedules to cron expressions and manual triggers

citations.quote: For each connection, you can select between three options that allow a sync to run. The three options for `Schedule Type` are: Scheduled, Cron, Manual
Runs the syncs based on the user-defined cron expression
If you prefer more precision in scheduling your sync, you can also use CRON scheduling to set a specific time of day or month.
